pli-tv-bi-vb-np7:1.2: tena kho pana samayena upāsakā bhikkhunī saṅghassa cīvaratthāya chandaṃkaṃ saṅgharitvā aññatarassa pāvārikassa ghare parikkhāraṃ nikkhipitvā bhikkhuniyo upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-bi-vb-np7:1.3: amukassa ayye pāvārikassa ghare cīvaratthāya parikkhāro nikkhitto, tato cīvaraṃ āharāpetvā bhājethā”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np7:1.4: bhikkhuniyo tena ca parikkhārena sayampi yācitvā bhesajjaṃ cetāpetvā paribhuñjiṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np7:1.6: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena saṅghikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpessantī”ti. …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-np7:1.7: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena saṅghikena saññācikena1 aññaṃ cetāpentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np7:1.10: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena saṅghikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpessanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np7:1.12: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np7:1.13.1: yā pana bhikkhunī aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena saṅghikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpeyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np7:2.12: yaṃ atthāya dinnaṃ taṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ cetāpeti payoge dukkaṭaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np7:2.14: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā ekabhikkhuniyā vā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np7:2.17: idaṃ me ayye aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena saṅghikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ, imāhaṃ saṅghassa nissajāmīti
pli-tv-bi-vb-np7:2.21.1: aññadatthike aññadatthikasaññā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np7:2.22: aññadatthike vematikā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np7:2.23: aññadatthike anaññadatthikasaññā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
